raw_text:
Here’s the full integrated 12-week plan from scratch, combining strength, cardio, mobility/recovery, and nutrition for a 36-year-old recreational lifter 6 months post–right medial meniscus tear. Constraints honored: no jumping/plyos, no deep knee flexion under load, progressive ROM only as tolerated. Goal: strength and return to skiing.

Structure overview
- Phases: 
  - Phase 1 Restore (Weeks 1–3)
  - Phase 2 Build (Weeks 4–6)
  - Phase 3 Integrate (Weeks 7–9)
  - Phase 4 Ski-Prep Peak (Weeks 10–12)
- Weekly training: 3 strength days (A lower, B upper, C lower), 2 cardio days, 1–2 recovery/mobility sessions.
- ROM guardrails: Start loaded knee flexion ~45–60°, progress toward 70–80° by Weeks 8–12 only if pain ≤2/10 and no swelling 24–48 h later.
- Loading: Begin ~RPE 6–7, progress to 7–8. Small weekly load/ROM bumps.

Phase 1: Restore capacity and control (Weeks 1–3)
Focus: Quad activation in limited ROM, hip hinge, hamstrings/calves, core/anti-rotation, balance. Bilateral bias; supported unilateral shallow ROM.

Week 1
- Day A (Lower + core)
  - Goblet box squat (high box, 3–0–3): 3x8 @ RPE 6
  - DB RDL: 4x8 @ RPE 6–7
  - Leg press (feet high, shallow ROM): 3x10 @ RPE 6
  - Band TKE: 3x15/side
  - Standing calf raise: 3x12
  - Side plank + top-leg abduction: 3x20–30 s/side
  - Farmer march: 3x20 steps
- Day B (Upper + light conditioning)
  - Seated cable row 4x10; DB bench 4x8; Neutral pulldown 3x10
  - Half-kneeling Pallof 3x12/side
  - Bike Z2 10–15 min
- Day C (Lower + core)
  - Trap-bar deadlift from blocks: 4x6 @ RPE 6–7
  - Reverse lunge to high step (short ROM): 3x6/side
  - Spanish squat iso (shallow): 4x20–30 s
  - Seated ham curl 3x12; Tibialis raises 3x15
  - Copenhagen plank (short lever) 3x15–20 s

Week 2
- Small ROM/load increases if symptom-free.
  - A: Goblet box squat 4x6 @ RPE 7; RDL 4x8; Leg press 3x10; TKE 3x15; Calf 4x10; Side plank abd 3x30–40 s; Farmer 3x24 steps
  - B: Add incline DB press 3x10; Bike 15–20 min Z2
  - C: Trap-bar blocks 5x5 @ RPE 7; Supported split squat to box 3x6/side; Spanish iso 4x25–30 s; Ham curl 3x12; Tib raise 3x15; Copenhagen short 3x20–25 s

Week 3
- Progress to ~60° if tolerated.
  - A: Box squat 4x6 @ RPE 7–8; RDL 4x6–8; Leg press 4x8; TKE 3x20; Calf 4x12; Side plank abd 3x35–45 s; Farmer 3x30 steps
  - B: Row 4x8; DB bench 4x8; Pulldown 3x8; 1-arm cable row 3x10/side; Pallof 3x12; Bike 20 min Z2 with 3x2-min Z3
  - C: Trap-bar blocks 5x4 @ RPE 7–8; Supported split squat 3x8/side; Spanish iso 4x30–35 s; Ham curl 4x10; Tib raise 3x15; Copenhagen medium 3x15–20 s
- Cardio (Weeks 1–3): 
  - S1 steady Z2 20–25 min; S2 6x1-min Z3/2-min easy (total 25–30 min)
- Mobility/recovery: Daily 8–12 min micro-dose + pre/post-lift warm-up/cooldown; 2x/week 20–30 min sessions (ankle rocks, TKEs, Spanish squat iso shallow, hip 90/90, lateral band walks, gentle stretches).

Phase 2: Build bilateral strength (Weeks 4–6)
Focus: Heavier bilateral lifts within ROM, progress isos, add lateral-chain strength. Cardio volume/density increases.

Week 4
- A: Safety bar box squat (medium-high box, 3–1–3): 5x4 @ RPE 7; RDL 4x6 @ 7–8; Leg press 4x8 @ 7; Spanish iso 4x35–40 s; Standing calf 4x12–15; Anti-rotation walkout 3x8/side
- B: Pull-up/assisted 4x6–8; Bench 5x5 @ RPE 7; Chest-supported row 4x8; Half-kneeling landmine press 3x10/side
- C: Trap bar floor or low blocks 5x3 @ RPE 7–8; Split squat to box 3x8/side; Seated ham curl 4x10; Lateral/monster walks 3x20 steps; Copenhagen medium 3x20–25 s
- Cardio:
  - S1 Power density: 4 x 7 x 30 s Z4/30 s easy; 3 min Z2 between sets (total 38–45 min)
  - S2 Tempo pyramid: 6/8/10/8/6 min high Z3, 3-min Z2 between (44–50 min)

Week 5
- A: SSB box squat 5x3 @ RPE 7–8; RDL 4x6 heavier; Leg press 4x8–10; Spanish iso 4x40–45 s; Calf 4x12–15; Walkout 3x10/side
- B: Bench 5x4 @ 7–8; Pull-up 4x6–8; Row 4x8; Landmine 3x8–10/side
- C: Trap bar 5x3 slightly heavier; Split squat 4x6–8/side; Ham curl 4x10; Lateral/monster 3x20; Copenhagen long 3x15–20 s
- Cardio:
  - S1 Power density: 4 x 8 x 30 s Z4/30 s easy
  - S2 Tempo pyramid: 8/10/12/10/8 min high Z3

Week 6 (mini-deload in lifting; cardio can still progress if knee calm)
- A: SSB box squat 4x3 @ RPE 7; RDL 3x6 @ 7; Leg press 3x8 @ 7; Spanish iso 3x40 s; Calf 3x12
- B: Bench 4x4 @ 7; Pull-up 3x6; Row 3x8; Landmine 3x8
- C: Trap bar 4x3 @ 7; Split squat 3x6/side; Ham curl 3x10; Lateral band 2x20; Copenhagen 2x20 s
- Cardio:
  - S1 Power density: 5 x 8 x 30 s Z4/30 s easy (if knee quiet)
  - S2 Extended pyramid: 10/12/14/12/10 min high Z3 (or repeat Week 5 if fatigued)

Phase 3: Integrate unilateral strength and control (Weeks 7–9)
Focus: Deeper but sub-parallel ROM, stronger split-stance, frontal/transverse stability, eccentric control. Cardio shifts to over-unders and strength endurance.

Week 7
- A: SSB squat to pins/box (safe depth, 3–1–3): 4x4 @ RPE 7–8; Barbell hip thrust 4x6–8 @ 7–8; Single-leg leg press 3x8/side (right cautious); Step-down 6–8" 3x6/side (3 s ecc); Seated calf 4x10–12; Dead bug 3x8/side
- B: 1-arm row 4x8/side; DB incline 4x8; Wide pulldown 3x10; Face pull + ER 3x12 each
- C: Trap bar 5x3 @ RPE 8; RFESS or front-foot–elevated split squat 3x6–8/side; Single-leg ham curl 3x10/side; Slider lateral lunge pattern 3x8/side; Copenhagen long 3x20–25 s
- Cardio:
  - S1 Over-unders: 3 x 12 min (2 min high Z3 + 1 min Z4), 4 min Z2 between
  - S2 Muscular endurance: Sled circuit 4–5 rounds OR bike climbs 5 x 6–7 min high Z3 (3-min Z2)

Week 8
- A: SSB pin/box squat 5x3 @ RPE 8; Hip thrust 4x6; SL leg press 3x8–10/side; Step-down 3x7–8/side; Seated calf 4x12–15
- B: Row 4x8; DB incline 4x8; Pulldown 4x8–10; Face pull + ER 3x12
- C: Trap bar 5x2 @ RPE 8–8.5; RFESS/FFESS 4x6/side; SL ham curl 3x10/side; Slider lateral 3x10/side; Copenhagen 3x25–30 s
- Cardio:
  - S1 Over-unders: 3 x 15 min (2 min high Z3 + 1 min Z4)
  - S2 Muscular endurance: Sled 5–6 rounds OR bike 6 x 6–7 min or 5 x 8 min high Z3

Week 9 (slight volume deload; maintain intensity)
- A: SSB squat 4x3 @ RPE 7–8; Hip thrust 3x6; SL leg press 3x8; Step-down 2x6; Calf 3x12
- B: Upper maintenance; light accessories
- C: Trap bar 4x2 @ RPE 8; Split squat 3x6; SL ham curl 3x10; Slider lateral 2x8; Copenhagen 2x20 s
- Cardio: 
  - S1 Endurance Z2 30–40 min
  - S2 Fartlek 30–40 min with 8–10 surges of 20–60 s to Z4 (full easy between)

Phase 4: Ski-prep and peak (Weeks 10–12)
Focus: Heavy but submax bilateral lifts; isometric endurance; lateral chain; threshold cardio; taper to peak.

Week 10
- A: SSB squat 5x3 @ RPE 8; Hip thrust 4x5 @ RPE 8; Leg press 4x6–8 @ RPE 8; Wall sit 4x45–60 s; Seated calf 4x12–15; Pallof to overhead 3x10/side
- B: Weighted pull-up 5x3–5; Bench 5x3–4 @ RPE 8; Chest-supported row 4x6–8; Lift/chop 3x8/side
- C: Trap bar 6x2 @ RPE 8–8.5 (3 s ecc first rep); RFESS/FFESS 4x6/side; SL ham curl 3x8–10/side; Lateral sled drag 4x20 m/side; Copenhagen 3x25–30 s
- Cardio:
  - S1 Threshold: 3 x 8–10 min low Z4 (4-min Z2)
  - S2 Station rotation (3–4 rounds): bike Z2 5 min; ski erg Z3 3 min; wall sit 60 s; easy 2 min; bike climb Z3 3 min; split-stance iso 30 s/side; easy 2 min

Week 11 (strategic overload)
- A: SSB squat 6x2 @ RPE 8–8.5; Hip thrust 5x3–5; Leg press 4x6; Wall sit 4x60–75 s
- B: Pull-up 4x5–6; Bench 5x3; Row 4x6–8; Face pulls 3x12
- C: Trap bar 5x2 @ RPE 8–9 if pristine; RFESS/FFESS 4x6–8/side; Lateral sled 4x20–30 m/side; Copenhagen 3x30–35 s
- Cardio:
  - S1 Over-unders extended: 3 x 15 min (2 min high Z3 + 1 min Z4)
  - S2 Muscular endurance: Sled 5–6 rounds OR bike 5 x 8–9 min high Z3 (shorten if legs are heavy)
- Nutrition tweak: +20–40 g carbs pre/post lower days this week.

Week 12 (peak with taper; feel strong and fresh)
- A: SSB squat 4x2 @ RPE 7–8; Hip thrust 3x3–5 @ RPE 7–8; Leg press 3x6–8 @ RPE 7; Wall sit 3x75–90 s
- B: Pull-up 3x5; DB bench 3x6–8; Row 3x8; Mobility + light accessories
- C: Trap bar 3x2 @ RPE 7–8; Split squat 3x6/side; Lateral sled 3x20 m/side; Copenhagen 2x30 s
- Optional neural primer 48–72 h pre “test” day: 2–3 x 2 on squat and trap bar @ RPE 6–7 + 1 x 45–60 s wall sit
- Cardio:
  - S1 Threshold maintenance: 2 x 8–10 min low Z4 (5-min Z2 between)
  - S2 Ski-specific mini-circuit: 2–3 rounds of ski erg 4 min Z3, wall sit 45–60 s, bike Z2 2 min, bike climb Z3 2 min, split-stance iso 30 s/side, easy 2 min

Recovery and mobility (all phases)
- Daily micro-dose (8–12 min): ankle rocks, heel-toe raises, quad sets/SLR, glute bridges, band TKEs, gentle hip flexor stretch; optional 5–8 min easy spin PM.
- Pre-lift warm-up (10–12 min): 5-min bike; lateral band walks; supported hip airplanes; TKEs; bodyweight box squats to session depth; add short step-downs on split-stance days.
- Post-lift cooldown (8–12 min): easy spin; soft tissue (quads, adductors, glutes, calves); hip flexor/quad/hamstring/adductor stretches.
- Recovery sessions (2x/week, 20–30 min): 
  - R1: Flush + mobility circuit (ankle rocks, shallow Spanish squat iso, 90/90, shallow box squats, lateral walks, calf eccentrics)
  - R2: Lateral chain + core (Copenhagen, side plank + abduction, Pallof, slider lateral pattern, step-downs)
- Pain rules: ≤2/10 during; no next-day swelling. Regress ROM/load if violated.

Nutrition (weight maintenance)
- Calories: Start at maintenance (BW lb x 14–15; or kg x 30–33 kcal). Adjust ±150–200 kcal based on weekly trend.
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day across 3–5 meals.
- Fat: 0.8–1.0 g/kg/day, mostly unsaturated.
- Carbs: Fill remainder; typically 3–5 g/kg/day. Prioritize around lower-body days.
- Timing: 
  - Pre-training (60–120 min): 30–70 g carbs + 20–40 g protein.
  - Post (0–2 h): 30–60 g carbs + 25–40 g protein.
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day; electrolytes for long/hot sessions.
- Supplements (optional): Creatine 3–5 g/day; Omega-3 (EPA/DHA 1–2 g/day); Vitamin D3 1,000–2,000 IU/day; collagen/gelatin 10–15 g + vitamin C 30–60 min pre-lower sessions; whey/casein as needed.

Readiness to return to skiing (end of Week 12)
- Pain-free tolerance to 70–80° loaded knee flexion.
- Wall sit 3 x 90 s without pain/swelling after.
- Step-downs 10/side from 8–10" with control, no valgus, pain ≤1/10.
- RFESS 4x6/side @ RPE ≤7 pain-free.
- Lateral sled drags 4x30 m/side with no next-day flare.
- No swelling/effusion 24–48 h after heavy lower sessions.

Key coaching notes
- Control depth with pins/boxes; increase 1–2 cm only when symptom-free.
- Emphasize 3–4 s eccentrics early, smooth cadence on cardio, avoid grinding low cadences that irritate the knee.
- Footwear/heel wedge allowed on squat days to modulate dorsiflexion.
- Stop and reassess with any locking, giving way, escalating joint-line pain, or effusion >48 h.

This plan progressively rebuilds strength and control, adds skiing-relevant lateral/isometric endurance, and peaks performance by Week 12 while respecting knee safety. Adjust weekly based on symptoms and quality.
